detail.title: Accountable Cross-Turn State Continuity
detail.question: How can durable state and mechanical constraints enable fresh model invocations to function as a singular, accountable process?
detail.reason: The project remains active as we seek to deepen the mechanical understanding of state continuity, building upon the established analogy-based governance models.

detail.title: Accountable Cross-Turn State Continuity
detail.summary: Persistent self-models and regulatory interfaces, functioning as mechanical constraints on autonomous agents, enable cross-turn accountability by bridging state discontinuities. The revised framework integrates behavioral tracking and authority-limiting architectures, drawing on analogies from legal durability and R&D automation maturity.
detail.reason: Synthesized findings for project-continuity-001 based on newly retrieved and integrated evidence on research agent autonomy and regulatory boundary setting.
